name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: Remote-Timer-as-a-Service: Efficient Microarchitectural Leakage in the Cloud with Remote Timers
items.dek: Microarchitectural timing side channels bypass Cloudflare Workers timer restrictions via amplification and remote-timer techniques, defeating Dynamic Process Isolation.
items.unproven: demonstration on production Cloudflare Workers; patch status and remediation timeline unclear at time of publication

items.title: CauSec: Unboxing the Causal Drivers of Static Vulnerability Analysis Performance
items.dek: Causal framework exposes whether SAST design tradeoffs (speed, precision) actually deliver promised gains or rest on invalid assumptions.
items.unproven: evaluation scope and tool coverage not yet specified in abstract; needs full dataset and tool set details

items.title: CVE-2026-64849 — MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
items.dek: MLflow MLflow. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 2 September.

items.title: Task-Conditioned Least-Privilege Learning for Executable Terminal and MCP Agents
items.dek: Post-training framework teaches 4B LLM agents task-conditioned least-privilege, reducing excess-authority errors from 35.6% to 1.5%.
items.unproven: Evaluated on simulated terminal and MCP environments; no data on real SDLC agent deployments or agent-to-human behavior drift.

items.title: COMA: A Compositional Misleading Attack Class on Security-RAG, and a Causal Counterfactual Defense
items.dek: Security RAG systems can be misled into recommending incomplete fixes via factually correct but compositionally adversarial documents; tested on five models and a real CVE.
items.unproven: whether adversaries can inject such documents at scale into security knowledge bases used by deployed copilots

items.title: MobileWorldSafety: Benchmarking GUI Agent Safety Against Environmental Injection Attacks in Android Apps
items.dek: Benchmark of 142 Android GUI agent attacks via environmental injection shows six agents vulnerable to indirect prompt injection in everyday mobile scenarios.
items.unproven: limited to six agents tested; real-world deployment impact of demonstrated attacks not measured

items.title: KeyPooling: Measuring Where LLM API Relay Paths Collapse Prompt Cache Isolation
items.dek: LLM API relays expose cross-customer prompt cache reads; KeyPooling measurement traces five open-source gateways and finds none bind customers to upstream credentials by default.
items.unproven: Weekly OpenRouter testing covered 80.5% of eligible token volume; full production behavior under all relay configurations not exhaustively characterized.

items.title: Trusted Workflow Relays:Cross-Tenant Email Abuse and Composable Red Team Initial-Access Primitives in Multi-Tenant Clouds
items.dek: Three cross-tenant notification workflows allow authenticated actors to reach other tenants and inject content through provider mail identities.
items.unproven: Findings are from three specific workflows that were responsibly disclosed and remediated; whether pattern persists in current or other cloud providers' notification systems is unclear.

items.title: When Agents Act on Web3: An Attack-Surface Survey of MCP, Skills, and Tool Calling
items.dek: MCP agent tool use on Web3 has shifted from 27% to 65% state-modifying; irreversibility and signing authority fundamentally change agent threat models.
items.unproven: measured protections and refusal rates are low (under 30% and 3%); defenses tested in limited scenarios; production deployment validation absent

items.title: CVE-2026-55040 — Microsoft SharePoint Weak Authentication Vulnerability
items.dek: Microsoft SharePoint. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 21 August.

items.title: CVE-2026-33824 — Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
items.dek: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 21 August.

items.title: CVE-2026-59310 — Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.dek: Broadcom VMware vCenter. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 21 August.

items.title: CVE-2025-62593 — Ray-Project Ray Code Injection Vulnerability
items.dek: Ray-Project Ray. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 21 August.

items.title: CVE-2026-65400 — Apple macOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.dek: Apple macOS. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 21 August.

items.title: Beyond the Transcript: Detecting Covert Co ordination in Latent Multi-Agent Communication
items.dek: Framework detects covert coordination in multi-agent LLM systems via latent-state monitoring and achieves 0.993 AUROC on homogeneous pairs.
items.unproven: whether real deployed multi-agent systems exhibit such coordination; scalability beyond the auction benchmark; robustness to agent obfuscation.

items.title: A single design choice determines whether machine learning models of materials make physically impossible predictions
items.dek: Parity labeling in neural material models determines whether physically impossible piezoelectric predictions occur; six orders of magnitude effect.
items.unproven: generalization beyond centrosymmetric crystals and piezoelectric constraints to other materials and properties used in cryptographic hardware

items.title: CTIFoundry: An Agent-Native Corpus Scaffold for Cyber Threat Intelligence
items.dek: Agent-native corpus scaffold for CTI materializes CVE/CWE/CAPEC/ATT&CK ontology and report structure for agentic investigation.
items.unproven: evaluation on CTIConnect benchmark only; readiness for production threat intelligence workflows and integration with reader's tools unclear

items.title: The Model's Tell: Measuring Context-Leakage Attack Signals with Behavior Gauges
items.dek: LeakGauge detects context leakage in LLMs via prefill token probabilities with AUROC 0.944–0.996 across 11 models without extracting hidden states.
items.unproven: whether detection at prefill time provides actionable defense before a response is committed, and whether the method generalizes to proprietary model APIs

items.title: Benchmarking Automated Security Patch Backporting: How Far Are We?
items.dek: Benchmark of 1,234 patch backporting cases reveals five automated tools degrade sharply on complex patches, contradicting single-repo success claims.
items.unproven: results limited to evaluated tool set; generalization to newly released tools untested

items.title: HarnessRisk: A Lifecycle-Oriented Benchmark for Agent Harness Safety
items.dek: Lifecycle benchmark identifies harness configuration as the most vulnerable phase, with attack success ranging 12.6% to 80.9% across three harnesses.
items.unproven: limited to three harnesses and six models; transferability to other agent frameworks not established

items.title: Reflex-Guard: A Low-Latency Guardrail for LLM Prompt Safety Using Dense Semantic Embeddings
items.dek: Local guardrail using embeddings and binary classifiers achieves 95.9% harmful prompt recall at 37.6 ms, 7× faster than LLM-based alternatives.
items.unproven: evaluation on curated dataset of 30k samples; robustness to adversarially optimized jailbreaks and zero-day attack patterns untested

items.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services
items.dek: Decomposition attacks succeed even with stateful defense if attackers use unlinkable identities; 1% block rate eliminates useful operating point under feedback.
items.unproven: Proofs assume fixed attack strategy without retries; real attacker behavior with adaptive strategies and identity chaining tactics not modeled.

items.title: Authorization Before Context: A Model-Neutral Audience Boundary Against Cross-Audience Memory Leakage in Agentic Systems
items.dek: Audience-boundary rule prevents cross-audience memory leakage in multi-tenant agents by enforcing authorization at context assembly, independent of model behavior.
items.unproven: evaluation limited to synthetic Contextual-Integrity suite; production multi-agent systems with real memory stores and channel ambiguity untested

items.title: AI-Generated GitHub Copilot "Autofix" Allowed Compromise of Snowflake's Jira
items.dek: Copilot-generated fix introduced authentication bypass in Snowflake's Jira; suggests checking AI-assisted remediation for security regressions.
items.unproven: whether this pattern is systematic across codebases or isolated to this incident; no measurement of fix-suggestion safety across large corpus

items.title: From Threat Intelligence to Detection: Knowledge-driven Enrichment and Template-based Rule Grounding for Automated Sigma Rule Generation
items.dek: AUTOSIGMA automatically generates platform-independent Sigma rules from unstructured threat intelligence using knowledge-base enrichment.
items.unproven: accuracy of rule grounding on real APT reports; false-positive rates when deployed in production SIEMs; maintenance burden of the knowledge base.

noise.title: Incident with Github.com
noise.dek: GitHub experienced an incident; status page notification with no technical detail disclosed.
noise.unproven: incident scope, root cause, and whether reader's infrastructure was affected remain unknown

noise.title: Using the railway network as a flatbed scanner
noise.dek: Railway network repurposed as a flatbed scanner in a technical novelty project.

noise.title: Field measurements of neighborhood-scale air temperature impacts of data centers
noise.dek: Study of thermal emissions from data centers in residential areas; outside application security.
